P2_MULTI.construction: two scan orders (H/V) and two nearest-neighbour orders; for each, raw order then 2-opt with at most 8 passes
P2_MULTI.natural: every core 2-opt segment ends with 'no_improving_2opt_move' or the 8-pass cap, the 120-pass deep stage and the 32-pass multi-start stages end the same way, and the wall-clock budget was not reached
P2_MULTI.budget_effect: the soft budget is the only external stop; when it fires the engine returns 'planned_at_timeout' with the best incumbent

TREE_MST.construction: one metric MST over pending targets + current position, one preorder in each direction, one fixed-endpoint 2-opt (<=8 passes)
TREE_MST.natural: the single construction finishes (one 2-opt pass sequence with no improving move or the 8-pass cap); there is no outer restart loop
TREE_MST.budget_effect: only the soft deadline can interrupt; the engine reports 'planned' or 'planned_at_timeout'

OARP_CORE2.construction: rank LP (SCIP) -> integer MIP fallback -> path sets -> directed start/end GTSP solved by the bundled GLNS
OARP_CORE2.natural: LP optimal and integral (or the MIP fallback optimal) AND the GTSP solver reports natural convergence (timeout=False)
OARP_CORE2.budget_effect: the rank budget cap is derived from the remaining time via the frozen runtime profile, so the number of allowed new ranks DEPENDS on the budget: this is a budget-conditioned algorithm
OARP_CORE2.warning: a GLNS time limit exhausted is NOT natural convergence; a SCIP optimum is optimal for the rank model, not for the coverage route

PPCPP_CORE4.construction: one deterministic core walk: reward-driven neighbour choice with a dead-end recovery jump, then the fixed return
PPCPP_CORE4.natural: the core route is built and passes the pre-return audit before the deadline
PPCPP_CORE4.budget_effect: only the soft deadline can interrupt; the engine reports its own core_status
PPCPP_CORE4.warning: a route that equals the shared fallback must be reported as fallback, not as a PPCPP result

EPSILON_STAR.construction: multiscale MAPS construction, then the ETM loop (one physical step per iteration), then the base return
EPSILON_STAR.natural: the ETM reaches FN because no positive potential remains at any level
EPSILON_STAR.budget_effect: the public soft deadline; a candidate whose audit finishes after the deadline is kept only as a diagnostic route
EPSILON_STAR.warning: state_cycle and the step cap are ARTIFICIAL safety truncations, not the paper's natural termination

excluded_this_round.CSTAR: restart diagnostic only; its real ledger never reaches the core planning state, so it is not a residual-task C* adaptation and does not enter the ranking
excluded_this_round.LKH: specification only, not downloaded or built

shared_fallback: P2_MULTI, TREE_MST, OARP_CORE2 and PPCPP_CORE4 each submit the shared old-suffix / common greedy candidates first; the report must show core, fallback and final source separately
